interpretation.label: substrate_not_ready_requeue
interpretation.summary: Substrate/arm readiness gate did not clear -- see interpretation.preconditions. Excluded seeds: {}.

preconditions.name: landmark_arm_behavioural_reach
preconditions.description: assert_behavioural_reach (tightened post-V3-EXQ-824): the boundary stream must reach (z_world, operating_mode) specifically, via use_anchor_sets and/or use_per_region_vs (REACH_CONSUMERS) -- use_invalidation_trigger alone no longer counts, since it only feeds a queue drained by a bounding flush with no causal reach.

preconditions.name: arm_statistics_not_degenerately_bit_identical
preconditions.description: V3-EXQ-824 sanity check (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-824_2026-07-26): rv_primary must NOT be bit-identical between ON and REMOVED at every valid seed. Exact float64 equality across independently-simulated seeds is the confirmed signature of the manipulation never reaching the measured statistic, not evidence of true landmark-invariance -- this is the check that would have caught 824's defect immediately.
preconditions.control: use_anchor_sets=True gives real reach to z_world

preconditions.name: landmark_arm_preserved_by_construction_fraction
preconditions.description: Fraction of seeds where the landmark-removal arm's Level-1 preservation (count/IEI-multiset/posterior-multiset/scale-mix) held exactly, per q081_landmark_removal.preservation_report.
preconditions.control: iei_permute is a rearrangement of the ON arm's own multiset

preconditions.name: landmark_arm_input_statistics_preserved_fraction
preconditions.description: Fraction of seeds where Level-2 input_statistics_divergence found no breach (the closed-loop confound check) -- a seed that breaches is CONFOUNDED, not a null, and is excluded.

preconditions.name: sufficient_valid_seeds_for_delta_sd
preconditions.description: At least 2 seeds must clear every precondition above (admissible primary statistic, artefact ruled out, preserved, unconfounded) to compute an SD of the ON-minus-REMOVED delta.

interpretation.outcome_taxonomy_note: This design adjudicates ONLY Outcome A vs Outcome B. Outcome C (unrelated) is partially visible in per-seed rv_p_value_vs_surrogate on the ON arm (a statistic that never clears its own null even intact leans C rather than A/B). Outcomes D (too-much-sharing-collapses) and E (event-relative beats clock-relative, incl. sleep-phase structure) need different comparator arms and are deferred to a lettered follow-up.

evidence_direction_note: use_anchor_sets fix makes the reach-check itself pass (landmark_arm_behavioural_reach=1.0) yet rv_primary stays bit-identical across all 5 seeds -- the reach-check confirms SOME causal path to z_world, not reach to the SPECIFIC measured pair. See Q081-REACH-CHECK-PAIR-SPECIFIC.
